description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open-source test management tool. It handles searching and displaying requirement specifications, including querying the database for requirement revision data based on various filters, and presenting the results in a table with links for editing and viewing revisions.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class used to generate and manage dynamic HTML tables with sorting and behavior.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A class encapsulating Smarty templating engine, used here for rendering the HTML output.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class managing test project data and hierarchy.

classes.name: cfield_design_values
classes.description: Table containing custom field design values for requirement specifications.

classes.name: nodes_hierarchy
classes.description: Tree structure for nodes within test projects, used for representing requirement hierarchies.

classes.name: req_specs_revisions
classes.description: Table of revisions of requirement specifications.

methods.name: buildExtTable
methods.description: Builds an HTML table displaying requirement specifications with links, based on the search results stored in the GUI object.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments from the request to be used for search filtering.
